title: Contract Oil & Gas Title/Due Diligence Landmen
job_description:
Company Overview
NorthStar Energy is a Denver, CO based full land and mineral services firm committed to delivering industry-leading service and expertise to our clients.

Job Description:

NorthStar Energy is seeking landmen with at least 3 years of oil & gas title experience in the Rockies or Permian Basin. This project will run through the end of 2026 and possibly longer.

Responsibilities:

Provide a due diligence review of leases and various other agreements and ensure accuracy of client's internal files and Quorum records.
Update mineral and leasehold ownership through research of county records.
Provide weekly updates as to progress.

Requirements:

Minimum of 3 years of proven experience determining mineral and leasehold title in Rockies or Permian Basin. Must outline work history timelines and areas worked on resume.
Ability to review, interpret and comprehend lease provisions.
Strong understanding of Pugh clauses, retained acreage and complex depth severances.
Analyze various agreements (JOAs, Unit Agreements, Farmout Agreements, etc.).
High attention to detail, organization and ability to analyze and manage large volumes of data.
Ability to manage time and work independently.
Communicate timely and professionally with Project Manager.
Proficient in Microsoft Office (especially Excel).
Navigate various databases.

Preferred Qualifications:

Quorum experience.
AAPL Membership.
JD, CPL or RPL.
Degree in Energy Management or Petroleum Land Management.
Bachelor's Degree.

Compensation:

Rates are based on experience and performance. There is opportunity for growth.

Start Date:

As soon as possible.

Experience:

Quorum : 1 year (Preferred)
determining mineral and leasehold title in Colorado or Texas: 3 years (Required)

Work Location: Remote
